meta.purpose: Consolidated research on existing surplus-chemical brokerages. These are the ACTUAL suppliers; ChemSurplus is the clean discovery/interface layer that aggregates their offerings and personalizes them by industry.
meta.method: Live SERP + page review of public brokerage sites
commonUxProblems: Raw paginated inventory tables with no filtering or search
Contact-form-to-inquire on every item — no self-serve discovery
No personalization: every visitor sees the same firehose regardless of industry
Dated 2000s-era visual design, poor mobile experience
Documentation (SDS/COA) hard to find or absent from listings
No structured categories or industry framing — buyers must already know the exact chemical
meta.ourWedge: Keep the brokerages as supply. Add the layer they lack: industry-personalized discovery, clean documented listings, search/filter, and one front door across many suppliers.
